coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team at Monzo,

I am writing to apply for the Senior Software Engineer position on your platform team. With seven years of backend engineering experience focused on distributed systems and payments infrastructure, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to a product used by millions of customers daily.

In my current role at FinTech Solutions Ltd, I led the migration of a monolithic payments platform to microservices running on Kubernetes. This project reduced our deployment cycle from fortnightly releases to same-day deployments and improved system resilience significantly. I also designed a Redis caching strategy that cut API latency by 40% at scale — the kind of performance challenge that I understand is central to Monzo's engineering culture.

My experience with PostgreSQL at scale, Kubernetes orchestration, and Python microservices aligns directly with your requirements. Beyond the technical skills, I bring a track record of mentoring engineers and driving technical direction through design reviews — something I'm keen to continue at Monzo.

I am eligible for a Skilled Worker visa and would welcome sponsorship support. I would be delighted to discuss how my background fits your platform team's roadmap.

Yours sincerely,
Amara Osei
